You are resolving an in-progress git merge in treams-rs (branch claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh). It merges commit 09f1ede (condensed into 8251007) ("PA4": refactors, performance work and correctness fixes in python/treams_rs/{_core,_operators,_tmatrix,_smatrix,_physics,_array,_source,_plane,_lattice,lattice,coeffs,ebcm,operators,iterative,io,support,config,init,main}.py and scripts/generate_agent_docs.py, plus regression tests) into the integration branch, which already contains the Python test-lane rewrites (PB0 foundation with tests/_support.py and mandatory category markers; PB1/PB2/PB3), the bindings lanes PA1/PA2/PA3, S1 and RB1. Do not abort the merge.

Conflicted (see git status): tests/test_docs.py, test_matrix_conveniences.py, test_periodic_callbacks.py, test_physics_api.py, test_plane_transforms.py, test_rotation.py, test_sources.py, test_support.py, and possibly others.

Rules:

  • Keep the test lanes' rewrites (check_pullback usage, table-driven tests, new invariants, category markers, _support helpers) AND PA4's intent: its regression tests for the fixes (Material with 0-d NumPy arrays, exact quarter-turn plane rotations, TMatrix.permute behaviour, empty-basis slabs, io ValueError for bad units, catalog changes, etc.) and any test updates required by PA4's behaviour changes. Inspect each side with git log -p MERGE_HEAD --not HEAD -- <file> and git log -p HEAD --not MERGE_HEAD -- <file>. Never drop an assertion that guards a real fix; drop a test only if it is genuinely covered elsewhere after the merge (say where in the commit message).
  • PB3 pinned some PA4-owned defects as strict xfails (e.g. tests/test_*::test_constructor_contract[smatrix-multipole-basis] — SMatrix accepting a multipole basis — and entries in docs/status.md's expected-failures list; also tests/test_support.py's UNCATALOGUED set containing treams_rs.ebcm.Modes and treams_rs.lattice.SumResult). If PA4 fixed them, the strict xfails will XPASS-fail (xfail_strict=true): turn them into plain tests, empty UNCATALOGUED accordingly, and remove the fixed entries from docs/status.md. Leave xfails for defects that remain.
  • Every test must carry a registered category marker (physics, ad_contract, python_contract, public_e2e, oracle_numerical); tests/test_suite_contract.py guards this.
  • Generated docs: run uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py after resolving and commit regenerated docs/api.md / llms.txt if they change; --check must pass.

Verification (all must pass before committing): cd treams-rs && just build-ext (cold target, a few minutes), .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && .venv/bin/ruff check ., uv run --no-sync pyrefly check, uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_agent_docs.py --check, the full uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, and PYTHONPATH=$PWD/python .venv/bin/python battery.py compare baseline.npz (must PASS). Rust is unaffected by this merge unless git shows Rust conflicts; if Rust files changed run cargo fmt --check --all and PYO3_PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings too. Commit the merge with message "Merge PA4: physics objects, operators and utility modules" plus a short body on the resolutions, ending with: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 noreply@anthropic.com Claude-Session: [link to a conversation in the cloud] Do NOT push; do not touch scratch: lanes or other branches. Report each conflict's resolution, xfails converted, and verification results.

PA4 (09f1ede (condensed into 8251007)) is merged into claude/treams-rs-improvements-snetmh as merge commit a53998e (condensed into 8251007), with parents e0f763f (condensed into 8251007) and 09f1ede (condensed into 8251007). Every required check passed before I committed. Nothing was pushed, and scratch: lanes and other branches were not touched.

Only the 8 test files listed in the task conflicted. PA4's source, script and generated-docs changes, and the other 9 test files it touched, merged without conflicts. The merge changes no Rust files, so I did not run the cargo checks.

How each conflict was resolved (the test lanes' rewrites are kept, and PA4's regression tests are added on top):

  • tests/test_support.py: started from HEAD's PB3 layout.
    • PA4's type-alias check and its "ufunc doc does not repeat the signature" check moved into _assert_resolves, so they now also cover the io namespace.
    • Added PA4's assertion on the realsumcw2d alias docstring, plus a check that ebcm.Modes, io.MatrixSet and lattice.SumResult are catalogued as type aliases.
    • Kept the _markdown import, which HEAD still needs; added the TypeAliasType import and encoding="utf-8" reads.
    • test_generated_documentation_is_source_current now also asserts that the generator's index_errors() is empty.
  • tests/test_docs.py: HEAD's version. I dropped PA4's test_generated_agent_docs_are_current because the extended test in test_support.py covers the same generator, the page index, docs/api.md and llms.txt. The commit message says where it is covered.
  • tests/test_physics_api.py: kept PB3's invariants and constructor table, and added three PA4 tests: test_multipole_responses_reject_plane_permutations (the permute TypeError), test_lossless_cluster_cross_sections_conserve_power (the cached radiation overlap) and test_periodic_conversions_validate_ports_before_solving. I added a python_contract marker to the last one.
  • tests/test_periodic_callbacks.py and tests/test_plane_transforms.py: kept HEAD's check_gradient and check_pullback forms instead of PA4's hand-written finite differences. Added PA4's test_custom_callback_rejects_invalid_media_and_labels and its two quarter-turn tests (exact label maps, and a turned layer cascading with ports built directly).
  • tests/test_matrix_conveniences.py, tests/test_rotation.py, tests/test_sources.py: only the imports conflicted, and I kept what both sides need. The unused finite_complex import is removed. PA4's tests for 0-d NumPy materials, read-only derived responses, shared k0/parity validation, rotated clusters and batched fields are all kept.

Xfails converted:

  • The UNCATALOGUED set is removed, and test_catalog_lists_every_public_definition now asserts that nothing is missing, because PA4 catalogues the type aliases.
  • No strict xfail turned into a pass. test_constructor_contract[smatrix-multipole-basis] stays an expected failure because PA4 did not fix it: SMatrix.__init__ still accepts a multipole basis. docs/status.md is therefore unchanged, and the other expected failures (Bessel sign, translation NaN, Wigner 3j, lattice-sum tiny shift, LU pivots flushed to zero under JAX) all remain.

Verification (all passed):
